These are genuine Triton 3.6.0 compiler outputs, captured from the handwritten
@triton.jit functions in kernels/atlas_jit_kernels.py using the installed
triton.compile(ASTSource(...), target=GPUTarget("cuda",89,32)) path. Compilation
runs in a fresh process/cache without a CUDA device launch or Inductor.

The three *.ttir files are byte-exact compiled.asm["ttir"] values. Their matching
*.capture.json files record the signature, constexprs, target/options, compiler
version, original source path and SHA256 hashes of both source and TTIR.
kernel.source.py is an exact snapshot of that source module. The original
source path/line locations are deliberately retained. Cache/CUDA artifacts
remain in the fresh /tmp run directories, not this fixture directory.

These outputs were captured by:

- /tmp/atlas-jit-final-bf16/capture/
- /tmp/atlas-jit-final-matmul/capture/
- /tmp/atlas-jit-final-mlp/capture/

No TTIR was handwritten or regenerated by a string template. Static-address
normalization derives TFunc/TOp/TValue objects separately, retains original
provenance, and is never labeled a new compiler-generated TTIR artifact.
Negative tests alter copies explicitly; the saved fixtures remain unchanged.
